hooks.command: cat >/dev/null || true; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph update --skip-flows --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || true

node -e 'const input=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8")); const p=input.tool_input?.file_path||""; const blocked=[/\.env$/,/\.env\.[^/]+$/,/(^|\/)dist\//,/(^|\/)\.well-known\//,/package-lock\.json$/,/pnpm-lock\.yaml$/]; if(blocked.some(r=>r.test(p))){console.error("BLOCKED by csp/secret guard: "+p+" (siehe CLAUDE.md Gotchas)"); process.exit(2)} process.exit(0)'
cat >/dev/null || true; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph status --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || echo 'Not a git repo, skipping'
